intro: The solar system, the night sky and space exploration.
p.universo.consejo: The v sounds like b: u-ni-BER-so. It contains millions of galaxies.
p.galaxia.consejo: Ours is called the Milky Way. The x sounds ks: ga-LAK-sya.
p.planeta.consejo: It is masculine although it ends in -a: «el planeta». Plural: «los planetas».
p.estrella.consejo: The ll sounds like y: es-TRE-ya. The Sun is a star.
p.cometa.consejo: It is masculine: «el cometa». Careful: «la cometa» is the kite that flies in the wind.
p.eclipse.consejo: It is masculine: «el eclipse». There are eclipses of the sun and of the moon.
p.órbita.consejo: It has an accent: the stress falls on the first syllable, ÓR-bi-ta. The Moon has its orbit.
p.girar.consejo: The g sounds like h: hi-RAR. You turn on yourself or around something.
p.brillar.consejo: The ll sounds like y: bri-YAR. Stars shine and so does the sun.
p.amanecer.consejo: It is also a verb: «amanece a las siete». «Al amanecer» means when the sun rises.
p.atardecer.consejo: It is also a verb: «atardece pronto en invierno». The opposite is «el amanecer».
p.telescopio.consejo: From Greek: «tele» is far and «scopio» is to look. Astronomers use it.
p.gravedad.consejo: It ends in d, so the stress is at the end: gra-be-DAD. It makes apples fall.
p.año luz.consejo: It measures distance, not time. Plural: «años luz».
b1.texto:
**What is up there.** The **universo** contains **galaxias**; ours is the Milky Way. The solar system has eight **planetas**. With a capital, **la Tierra** is the planet; with a small letter, **la tierra** is the soil.

**Movement.** The Earth **gira** around the Sun and on itself. The Moon follows its **órbita**. **Estrellas** **brillan**.

**The sun.** It rises and sets. The **amanecer** and the **atardecer** are the two moments of the day.

**The night.** There are constellations, shooting stars and **cometas**. An **eclipse** happens when one body blocks the light of another. Distances are measured in **años luz**. **Gravedad** keeps everything in place.

**Looking.** An astronomer uses a **telescopio**.

**Idioms.** **Estar en la luna** (to be distracted), **pedir la luna** (to ask for the impossible), **nacer con estrella** (to be born lucky).
b2.f0.texto: Do you see that star that shines so much?
b2.f1.texto: I think it is the brightest planet in the sky.
b2.f2.texto: The stars are many light years from Earth.
b2.f3.texto: With a telescope you can see the rings of Saturn.
b2.f4.texto: The Earth revolves around the Sun.
b2.f5.texto: Gravity keeps the Moon in its orbit.
b2.f6.texto: They say there will be an eclipse at sunset.
b2.f7.texto: Then we will come up here again to see it.
b4.titulo: «Por... que» and «aunque»: even if it is hard
b4.texto:
To say «no matter how much», use **por** + adjective or **por mucho** + **que** + **subjunctive**:

- **Por brillante que sea**, la estrella no se ve de día.
- **Por mucho que mires**, no verás el final del universo.

With **aunque** + subjunctive you speak of something possible but not certain: **Aunque llueva**, saldremos a mirar el cielo. With **aunque** + indicative you speak of something we already know: **Aunque llueve**, saldremos.
b4.e0.texto: However bright it is, the star cannot be seen by day.
b4.e1.texto: However much you look, you will not see the end of the universe.
b4.e2.texto: Even if it rains, we will go out to look at the sky.
b5.f0.texto: On top of the hill, the sky opens like an enormous black bowl.
b5.f1.texto: Thousands of stars tremble above the sleeping trees.
b5.f2.texto: The galaxy draws a pale cloud above the horizon.
b5.f3.texto: My father points to a reddish dot near the horizon.
b5.f4.texto: We speak in a low voice, as if the universe could hear us.
b5.f5.texto: Suddenly a comet crosses the sky and leaves a tail of luminous dust.
b5.f6.texto: Its glow lasts barely a second and stays engraved in my memory.
b5.f7.texto: Then the Moon peeps out in the east, big, orange and calm.
b5.f8.texto: With the dawn, the sky turns pale and fills with a very soft blue.
b5.f9.texto: When the sun finally rises, we still carry the whole night in our eyes.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: the Earth is a planet and goes round the Sun.
b6.o1.refuerzo: A telescope is an instrument for looking; it does not go round the Sun.
b6.o2.refuerzo: A light year is a distance, not a heavenly body.
b7.frase: La Luna sigue su ____ alrededor de la Tierra.
b7.o0.refuerzo: Yes: the orbit is the path of one body around another.
b7.o1.refuerzo: An eclipse is when one body blocks another's light.
b7.o2.refuerzo: Gravity is a force, not a path.
b7.pregunta: Which word names the path of a heavenly body?
b8.frase: Al amanecer todavía brillaban algunas estrellas
b8.traduccion: At dawn some stars were still shining
b9.o1.refuerzo: Yes: «estar en la luna» is not paying attention.
b9.pregunta: What does «estar en la luna» mean?
b11.frase: Por breve que ____, no mires al Sol.
b11.o1.refuerzo: The indicative is not used in this structure.
b11.o2.refuerzo: The future is not used in this structure either.
b12.o0.refuerzo: Although it has «año», it does not measure time.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Yes: it is the distance light travels in a year.
b12.pregunta: What does a light year measure?
p.ves.consejo: The v sounds like «b». It is a very short word.
p.anillos.consejo: The ll sounds like «y»: a-NI-yos. Masculine: «el anillo».
p.subiremos.consejo: Future of «subir». The stress is on RE.
p.mires.consejo: Used after «por mucho que» or «por breve que»: «por breve que mires».
p.verás.consejo: Future of «ver». The v sounds like «b».
p.cima.consejo: The c before i sounds like «th». Feminine: «la cima».
p.cuenco.consejo: Masculine: «el cuenco». The c before o sounds like «k».
p.miles.consejo: «Miles» is used in the plural: «miles de estrellas».
p.dormidos.consejo: From «dormir». The o in dormir changes to «ue» in some forms.
p.pálida.consejo: Feminine of «pálido», agreeing with «nube». The stress is on PA.
p.horizonte.consejo: The h is silent. Masculine: «el horizonte».
p.oírnos.consejo: The pronoun «nos» attaches at the end of the infinitive: «oír» + «nos».
p.grabado.consejo: «Quedarse grabado» means to stay fixed in your memory.
p.memoria.consejo: Feminine: «la memoria». The stress is on MO.
p.asoma.consejo: «Asomar» is to show a part of something. Stress on SO.
p.palidece.consejo: Comes from «pálido», pale. The c before e sounds like «th».
p.brillaban.consejo: The -aban ending is the past continuous: «brillaban» means «were shining».
p.algunas.consejo: Feminine of «algunos», used before a noun: «algunas estrellas».
p.distancia.consejo: Feminine: «la distancia». The c before i sounds like «th».
